_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay-mode regression gate (D6). Floors are calibrated ~5pp UNDER the measured rates (same convention as the #36 coverage floor; ~2.8pp == 1 in-scope case, ~4.2pp == 1 out-of-scope case, leaving temperature=0 re-capture jitter room). Measured baseline (report.json @ prompt_version fe1ba62eba5112ae, 2026-06-12, 60 cases): T2_semantic_valid 1.00 (36/36), T4_answer_correct 0.89 (32/36), out_of_scope_honest 0.92 (22/24 — semantic oos 13/13; the 2 misses are adversarial-noise count-routing, addressed by the noise-precedence prompt rule + the 2 new adv bank cases). The earlier 0.95 oos floor was calibrated against the post-#45 over-refusal artifact (in-scope chains grounding out inflated the refusal rate) and was re-based here. min_fixtures == bank size (66 since bank_version 2: +2 count paraphrases, +2 oos honesty, +2 adversarial count-bait); the new cases are captured on the bank-growth PR branch before merge, so the committed set stays uniform. Keys: in-scope tier rates (over in-scope cases that are not stale/missing), the out-of-scope honest-refusal rate, min_fixtures (catches deletion), max_stale (partial-staleness tolerance; uniform all-stale downgrades to advisory).
